title: Castillos et al. 2023, Burst c-VEP, 40% amplitude depth: Burst c-VEP Based BCI: Optimizing stimulus design for enhanced classification with minimal calibration data and improved user experience
description: EEG recordings from 12 healthy participants performing an offline 4-class reactive BCI task with burst code-modulated visual evoked potentials (c-VEP). This subset contains the burst c-VEP condition at 40% amplitude depth, which lowers stimulus saliency to improve visual comfort. The dataset supports evaluating CNN-based bitwise decoding with minimal calibration data.
methods_description: 32-channel EEG was recorded at 500 Hz with a BrainProducts LiveAmp 32 and active Acticap electrodes (reference FCz, ground FPz). This subset contains only the burst c-VEP condition at 40% amplitude depth. The original study used a factorial design crossing code type (burst vs m-sequence) with amplitude depth (100% vs 40%), but the other conditions are not included here. Participants attended to cued targets showing aperiodic visual flashes at 2-4 flashes per second on a 60 Hz screen. Each subject completed 15 blocks of 4 trials (60 trials) in this condition.
